statement: Frozen before any Sprint 8 live model run. The Sprint 8 holdout (10 cases per scenario) was written from each scenario's documented meaning before any Sprint 8 model output existed and is never used for prompts, feedback, semantic evidence or tuning. Sprint 7's inspected holdout is kept as `development`.

budget.model: gemini-3.5-flash-lite (Firebase AI Logic, ONLY_IN_CLOUD) and Gemini Nano (ONLY_ON_DEVICE)
budget.retries: none: a provider failure is recorded as a failure and is not repeated or replaced
budget.stopRule: Stop when trials 1–5 are complete or the request cap is reached, whichever comes first. No trial is discarded.
budget.authorization: Each request goes through the in-app approval gate; the live spec approves exactly what it previews.

configurations.A: Deterministic test proposer over the approved disclosure. No model. Computed offline.
configurations.B: Real Gemini proposal from the approved disclosure. No Nano, no revision.
configurations.C: Real Gemini Nano private interpretation (validated suggestions applied by the user) + real Gemini proposal.
configurations.D: C + one approved real Gemini revision with Blind Revision Feedback; every trusted constraint behind a semantic finding is authorized (recorded as a human intervention).

hypotheses.H1: The semantic verifier flags the schema-valid-but-wrong holdout outputs of real Gemini mappings caused by date order and priority inversion, with no false alarms.
hypotheses.H2: With approved semantic constraints, one real Gemini revision increases holdout correct transformations over C with zero holdout regressions in CRM and support.
hypotheses.H3: Nano (C vs B) does not change holdout correctness on these fixtures (expected null result).
hypotheses.H4: Codes-only semantic feedback (no constraint) is insufficient for a correction (tested offline with the simulated reviser only; not a live claim).

primaryMetric: Holdout correct transformations (ground-truth equal output, transformed or approved rule). Quarantine never counts.
